notes: Expanded EVAL-F5 with full story coverage across schema, logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.note: Transforms raw signals into explainable format
Connects F1/F2/F3 outputs into explainability layer

stories.title: Explainability Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a standardized schema for evaluation explainability including fields for source, meaning, and limitations. Implement as Pydantic models to ensure consistent structure across provider and clinical trial signals.

stories.title: Explainability Core Logic Builder
stories.description: Implement backend logic to transform raw evaluation signals (credentials, links, trial data) into standardized explainability objects, enriching each signal with source attribution, user-friendly meaning, and known limitations.

stories.title: Expose Explainability via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include explainability fields in responses for both provider and clinical trial queries, ensuring compatibility with existing tool routing and response structures.

stories.title: Integrate Explainability with Upstream Evaluation Signals
stories.description: Integrate explainability generation directly into the data flow of provider and clinical trial services, ensuring every exposed evaluation signal includes an explainability payload before reaching the facade layer.

stories.title: Explainability Layer Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests to validate explainability schema compliance, correctness of source attribution, and consistency of meaning/limitations across provider and clinical trial scenarios.
